== Quotes ==

* My method is to take the utmost trouble to find the right thing to say, and then to say it with the utmost [[levity]].
** ''Answers to Nine Questions'' (1896)
* '''[[Patriotism]] is, fundamentally, a conviction that a particular country is the best in the world because you were born in it.'''<ref>{{cite web|title=minta}}</ref>
** ''The World'' (1893)
*
* A life spent making mistakes is not only more [[w:Honour|honorable]], but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.
* Negyedik idézet, ami már nem fér bele a maximumba.
